demos.name: LuxeCart
demos.summary: Swiss watch boutique with interactive 360° studio angle viewer, strap variant selector, wishlist, shipping calculator, and validated demo checkout.
demos.testGuide: Rotate watch angles in the 360° viewer, filter by movement, save favorites, add straps/pieces to your bag, and complete the sample checkout.

demos.name: Pulse
demos.summary: Multi-view SaaS metrics workspace with date-range recalculation, interactive SVG revenue trends, sortable plan cohorts, and alert toggles.
demos.testGuide: Switch between 7d, 30d, 90d, and 12m ranges, sort account rows, inspect cohort retention, and toggle workspace alert rules.

demos.name: Ember Kitchen
demos.summary: Seasonal menu explorer with dietary filters, tasting-tray takeaway order builder, and a validated table reservation flow.
demos.testGuide: Filter dishes by course or dietary tag, add items to a takeaway tray, or submit a validated table reservation.

demos.name: Haven
demos.summary: Property discovery portal with multi-criteria search, interactive monthly mortgage estimator, saved listings, and agent viewing requests.
demos.testGuide: Filter properties by city, bedrooms, and budget, calculate monthly payments, save listings, and send a sample agent inquiry.

demos.name: Northline
demos.summary: Digital product studio website featuring filterable case studies, an interactive project scope estimator, and a validated brief submission form.
demos.testGuide: Filter studio case studies, configure deliverables in the scope estimator, and submit a validated project brief.

demos.name: Synth Studio
demos.summary: Browser-based prompt engineering studio with preset templates, output format/tone controls, deterministic sample synthesis, and prompt history.
demos.testGuide: Pick a workflow preset or type a prompt, adjust tone and output format, generate sample structured responses, and copy or reload history.

demos.name: Forge Docs
demos.summary: Technical documentation reader with instant section search, SDK language switcher, copyable code blocks, and an interactive API response simulator.
demos.testGuide: Search across guides, switch CLI/Node/cURL snippets, copy code blocks, and test sample API endpoint responses.

demos.name: Atelier Noir
demos.summary: Minimalist fashion storefront with editorial lookbook filtering, size and colorway selectors, wishlist, and a validated order bag.
demos.testGuide: Filter garments by capsule, choose sizes and color swatches, save items to your wishlist, and test bag checkout.

demos.name: Voltix Gear
demos.summary: Consumer hardware storefront with an interactive 360° studio angle viewer, finish selector, side-by-side spec comparison, and cart checkout.
demos.testGuide: Inspect hardware angles in the 360° studio viewer, compare audio/battery specs across models, and add configurations to cart.

demos.name: Kanso Living
demos.summary: Modern furniture store with interactive 360° angle inspection, timber/upholstery finish switcher, room dimensions guide, and delivery estimator.
demos.testGuide: Rotate furniture angles in the 360° viewer, switch oak/walnut/bouclé finishes, check dimensions, and test freight checkout.

demos.name: Lumina Botanicals
demos.summary: Skincare e-commerce storefront with a 3-step skin-type routine builder, active ingredient breakdowns, bundle savings, and cart checkout.
demos.testGuide: Filter formulas by skin concern, build a custom 3-step routine bundle, inspect key ingredients, and test checkout.

demos.name: FreshCart
demos.summary: Neighborhood grocery delivery interface with aisle filters, organic/vegan badges, delivery time-slot scheduler, and live basket totals.
demos.testGuide: Browse aisles, filter organic items, adjust item quantities in your basket, pick a delivery window, and confirm a sample order.

demos.name: Solis Stays
demos.summary: Boutique hospitality booking platform with destination filters, guest and night calculators, room tier comparison, and reservation validation.
demos.testGuide: Filter retreats by region, adjust nights and guest count to recalculate stay totals, and complete a sample reservation.

demos.name: Apex Motors
demos.summary: Automotive showroom featuring an interactive 360° angle viewer, exterior paint & wheel configurator, monthly lease estimator, and test-drive booking.
demos.testGuide: Switch vehicle angles in the 360° viewer, customize paint and wheel trims, calculate monthly lease terms, and book a sample test drive.

demos.name: SkillForge
demos.summary: Online learning workspace with track filters, interactive syllabus checklist, lesson notes reader, and a self-checking knowledge quiz.
demos.testGuide: Enroll in a sample track, mark lessons complete to update progress, read lesson notes, and answer the interactive checkpoint quiz.

demos.name: TalentGrid
demos.summary: Curated tech job board with role, remote-policy, and minimum salary filters, saved roles shortlist, and a validated quick-apply drawer.
demos.testGuide: Filter open roles by stack and remote policy, bookmark roles, inspect full role specs, and submit a sample application.

demos.name: Meridian Press
demos.summary: Digital publication with topic filters, full in-page article reader, reading-list bookmarks, and a validated weekly digest signup.
demos.testGuide: Filter essays by topic, open any essay in the distraction-free reader, save articles to your reading list, and test newsletter signup.

demos.name: StagePass
demos.summary: Event discovery and ticketing interface with city/category filters, ticket tier quantity selector, promo code validation, and sample pass preview.
demos.testGuide: Filter upcoming conferences and workshops, select General or VIP pass quantities, apply sample code PROBOY10, and generate a demo pass.

demos.name: IronPulse
demos.summary: Fitness club web app with day-of-week class schedule filtering, one-click spot reservation, membership plan comparison, and trial pass form.
demos.testGuide: Filter studio classes by day or discipline, reserve a class spot, compare membership tiers, and request a validated trial pass.

demos.name: CarePoint Clinic
demos.summary: Clinic scheduling interface with department filters, practitioner availability slots, and validated appointment booking (UI scheduling demo only).
demos.testGuide: Filter practitioners by department, pick an available date and time slot, and test appointment confirmation. UI demo only — no medical advice.

demos.name: ClientFlow CRM
demos.summary: Customer relationship dashboard with stage filtering, account search, slide-over contact inspector, and local deal-stage updates.
demos.testGuide: Search sample accounts, filter by pipeline stage, open a contact record, add a note, and advance deal stages in local demo state.

demos.name: SprintBoard
demos.summary: Agile Kanban board where visitors can create tasks, filter by priority, move cards across Backlog, In Progress, Review, and Done, and reset state.
demos.testGuide: Add a new task card, filter by priority tag, move cards between workflow columns, and reset the board anytime.

demos.name: MemberVault
demos.summary: Subscription membership portal with monthly/annual billing toggle, tier entitlement matrix, active plan switcher, and sample invoice history.
demos.testGuide: Toggle monthly vs. annual pricing, compare member perks, switch simulated active tiers, and inspect sample billing records.

demos.name: LedgerNote
demos.summary: Invoicing and receivables workspace with status filters, an interactive line-item invoice builder, and a print-ready invoice preview (sample data).
demos.testGuide: Filter sample invoices by Paid/Pending/Overdue, create a custom invoice with live tax/total math, and open the print-ready preview.
